```{python}
#| include: false
# Private working view. Reads the dbt marts in DuckDB. Never publish the rendered file:
# it contains personal health data (dashboard/*.html is git-ignored).
import os
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

DB = Path(os.environ.get("SELVRA_DUCKDB", Path.cwd().parent / "data" / "selvra.duckdb"))
con = duckdb.connect(str(DB), read_only=True)


def q(sql: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return con.execute(sql).df()


days = q("select * from marts.mart_analysis_days order by reading_date")
days["reading_date"] = pd.to_datetime(days["reading_date"])
last = days["reading_date"].max()
recent = days[days["reading_date"] > last - pd.Timedelta(days=14)]
last_reading = q("select arg_max(reading_at_local, reading_at) as t from intermediate.int_cgm_flagged")["t"].iloc[0]

# Consensus colours for glucose ranges (AGP report convention)
RANGES = [
    ("<3.0", "#8b1a1a"), ("3.0–3.9", "#e0453a"), ("3.9–10.0", "#3aa655"),
    ("10.0–13.9", "#f2c12e"), (">13.9", "#f08c2e"),
]
INK, MUTED, GRID = "#1d1d21", "#6b6b73", "#e6e6e3"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.figsize": (9, 3.6), "figure.dpi": 110, "font.size": 9,
    "axes.edgecolor": GRID, "axes.labelcolor": MUTED, "axes.grid": True, "grid.color": GRID,
    "xtick.color": MUTED, "ytick.color": MUTED, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
    "legend.frameon": False,
})


def date_axis(ax):
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b %Y"))
```

```{python}
#| title: "Coverage per day · dashed line = 70 % threshold, red = invalid day"
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
colours = ["#3aa655" if v else "#e0453a" for v in days["is_valid_day"]]
ax.bar(days["reading_date"], days["coverage_pct"], width=1.0, color=colours)
ax.axhline(70, color=INK, linestyle="--", linewidth=1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax.set_ylabel("% of expected readings")
date_axis(ax)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Ambulatory glucose profile · last 14 days, artefacts excluded"
agp = q(f"""
    select
        (extract(hour from reading_at_local) * 60 + floor(extract(minute from reading_at_local) / 15) * 15) / 60.0 as hour,
        quantile_cont(glucose_mmol, 0.05) as p05, quantile_cont(glucose_mmol, 0.25) as p25,
        quantile_cont(glucose_mmol, 0.50) as p50, quantile_cont(glucose_mmol, 0.75) as p75,
        quantile_cont(glucose_mmol, 0.95) as p95
    from intermediate.int_cgm_flagged
    where reading_date > date '{last.date()}' - 14
      and not (flag_compression_low or flag_implausible_jump)
    group by 1 order by 1
""")
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.axhspan(3.9, 10.0, color="#3aa655", alpha=0.07, linewidth=0)
ax.fill_between(agp.hour, agp.p05, agp.p95, color="#3c6ec8", alpha=0.13, linewidth=0, label="5–95 %")
ax.fill_between(agp.hour, agp.p25, agp.p75, color="#3c6ec8", alpha=0.35, linewidth=0, label="25–75 %")
ax.plot(agp.hour, agp.p50, color="#1f3f8f", linewidth=2.2, label="Median")
for y in (3.9, 10.0):
    ax.axhline(y, color="#3aa655", linewidth=1)
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 3))
_ = ax.set_xticklabels([f"{h:02d}:00" for h in range(0, 25, 3)])
ax.set_ylim(2, 20)
ax.set_ylabel("mmol/L")
ax.legend(loc="upper right", ncols=3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Time in ranges per day (mmol/L)"
bands = {
    "<3.0": days["tbr_level2_pct"],
    "3.0–3.9": days["tbr_pct"] - days["tbr_level2_pct"],
    "3.9–10.0": days["tir_pct"],
    "10.0–13.9": days["tar_pct"] - days["tar_level2_pct"],
    ">13.9": days["tar_level2_pct"],
}
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
bottom = pd.Series(0.0, index=days.index)
for name, colour in RANGES:
    ax.bar(days["reading_date"], bands[name], bottom=bottom, width=1.0, color=colour, label=name)
    bottom = bottom + bands[name]
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylabel("% of readings")
date_axis(ax)
ax.legend(loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.0), ncols=5)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Artefact flags per week"
flags = q("""
    select date_trunc('week', reading_date) as week,
           sum(flag_compression_low::int) as compression_low,
           sum(flag_implausible_jump::int) as implausible_jump,
           sum(flag_censored::int)         as censored
    from intermediate.int_cgm_flagged group by 1 order by 1
""")
flags["week"] = pd.to_datetime(flags["week"])
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
bottom = pd.Series(0.0, index=flags.index)
for col, label, colour in [
    ("compression_low", "Compression low", "#7a5cc7"),
    ("implausible_jump", "Implausible jump", "#c75c8a"),
    ("censored", "Low/High (censored)", "#5c8ac7"),
]:
    ax.bar(flags["week"], flags[col], bottom=bottom, width=6, color=colour, label=label)
    bottom = bottom + flags[col]
ax.set_ylabel("Readings")
date_axis(ax)
ax.legend(loc="upper left", ncols=3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Days

```{python}
#| title: "Last 30 days · metrics, flags and logged context"
cols = {
    "reading_date": "Date", "coverage_pct": "Coverage %", "mean_mmol": "Mean", "cv_pct": "CV %",
    "tir_pct": "TIR %", "tbr_pct": "TBR %", "tbr_pct_clean": "TBR % (no artefacts)",
    "n_artefact": "Artefacts", "sensor_change_inferred": "Sensor change (inferred)",
    "sensor_change_logged": "Sensor change (logged)", "is_ill": "Ill", "had_alcohol": "Alcohol",
    "had_training": "Training", "notes": "Notes",
}
table = days.sort_values("reading_date", ascending=False).head(30)[list(cols)].rename(columns=cols)
table["Date"] = table["Date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
table = table.fillna("")
for c in ["Sensor change (inferred)", "Sensor change (logged)", "Ill", "Alcohol", "Training"]:
    table[c] = table[c].map({True: "yes", False: ""})
table.style.hide(axis="index").format(precision=1)
```

# Log completeness

## Row {height=35%}

```{python}
#| title: "Sensor changes: what the data suggests vs what you logged"
sc = q("""
    select
        count(*) filter (where sensor_change_inferred and sensor_change_logged)     as "Inferred and logged",
        count(*) filter (where sensor_change_inferred and not sensor_change_logged) as "Inferred, not logged",
        count(*) filter (where sensor_change_logged and not sensor_change_inferred) as "Logged, not inferred"
    from marts.fct_day_context
""")
sc.style.hide(axis="index")
```

## Row

The comparison measures how complete the event log is. A sensor change the data suggests but the log lacks is either a missing log entry or a false inference, for example a long signal gap. Check those days before using sensor-change context in an analysis.
